Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the counterparty in the transaction.

Branch.name: Branch
Branch.definition: Identification of the branch of the counterparty, when the transaction concludes a transaction through a branch office.

CountryCode.name: Country Code
CountryCode.definition: Country where the registered office of the counterparty is located or country of residence in case that the counterparty is a natural person.
